name: Ducati Paso 750 / 906 / 907
engine: 748 or 904 cc air/oil or liquid-cooled desmo V-twin, carb then fuel injection on the 907
intro: Ducati's fully faired Paso. Bodywork hides everything, and the 907 ie brought fuel injection.

H: Desmo valve service needs both opening and closing shims checked. Follow the interval in the manual; it is not a job to skip.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
